title: Quarterly partner review
description: Review the quarter with the Northwind team. Prep: bring the updated forecast and draft the summary memo.

title: New client onboarding standup
description: Kick off onboarding for Cedar Systems. Prep: provision the staging environment and confirm API credentials.

title: Engineering working session
description: Working session with the platform team. Prep: circulate the scope doc and a draft agenda.

title: Dentist appointment
description: Routine check-up. Remember to bring insurance card.

title: Co-marketing call
description: Joint campaign planning with Orchard Labs. Prep: finish the joint one-pager draft and prepare the hardware lead intro.

title: Board prep
description: Monthly board sync. Prepare for the board meeting: build the pipeline report, refresh the metrics deck, and write the narrative summary.

title: Pilot kickoff
description: Kick off the Bluepeak pilot. Need the data schema sent and the shared channel created.

title: Family birthday dinner
description: Dinner out with family. Prep: book the reservation and pick up the cake and card.

title: Conference speaker rehearsal
description: Run-through for the conference talk. Prep: finalize slides and confirm A/V requirements with organizers.

title: Legal review call - vendor NDA
description: Walk through the NDA redlines. Prep: review comments and prepare questions.

title: Deep work - grant narrative
description: Focused writing block for the grant application. Prep: outline the budget justification.

title: Integration sync
description: Sync on integration milestones with the partner team. Prep: prepare the integration spec.

title: 1:1 with hardware lead
description: Weekly one-to-one. Prep: bring the approved BOM and pricing sign-off.

title: Lunch with mentor
description: Catch-up lunch, nothing on the agenda. No prep needed.

title: Investor meeting planning
description: Plan the annual investor meeting. Prep: finalize the agenda, confirm the venue, and assign slide owners for the performance deck.

title: Holiday - Office closed
description: Office is closed for the public holiday. No meetings.

title: Quarterly tax check-in
description: Review the quarter's books with the accountant. Prep: categorize May transactions and gather the hosting and travel receipts.
